title: Design Day Bangalore — Typeface Design
description:
#Bangalore #TypefaceDesigner #DesignersOnly

Typography and selection of fonts is a key element of a balance design. More critical is designing the right typeface/font for the right context. Join the 25th Edition of Design Day Bangalore to learn the basics from the experts who have been designing typefaces for a long time.

Get insights into use cases and participate in a hands on jam session

This session will be most helpful to:

-------------------------------------------

1. Students and practising designers in Graphic & Communication Design.

2. Typography and Font Design Enthusiasts.

This is strictly a designers only event. For designers who wish to collaborate and co create with fellow designers.

Saturday, November 15 at 9:30am - 1:30pm
IBM Embassy Golf Links Park. Bangalore
Block A, Cafeteria.

Due to logistical issues we would need to limit the number of participants to the first 50 Registrations on a First come First Serve basis.
